newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Futuris sells woolstores for A$63 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Futuris sells woolstores for A$63 mln.

text.p: Futuris Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it had sold the major wool stores owned by its unit Elders Australia Ltd for A$63 million.
Futuris said the sale generated a post-tax profit of A$16 million.
Futuris said the woolstores would be leased back to Elders at market rental for at least 15 years.
The total proceeds from the sale will be used by Elders to provide enhanced services to woolgrowers and processors, Futuris said.
The stores was located in Lara, Victoria, Gillman, South Australia and atnSpearwood in Western Australia.
Futuris took full control of Elders earlier this year after a long drawn out takeover bid.
Futuris declined to name the purchaser of the wool stores.
A company official said it was up to the purchaser to make any such disclosure.
But he added that all three wool stores went to to same buyer.
